purpose: エリア画面の連続シーン背景。3ホットスポット（①テストルーム ~20%左, ②プランナー席 ~52%, ③デザイン席 ~80%）
scene: The floor of a small cozy game studio as one continuous miniature clay diorama, left to right: a test room corner with a rack of small game consoles, one monitor showing a tiny crash symbol and a clipboard; a planner's desk in the middle with a big wall chart of colorful bar graphs and sticky notes; a designer's desk at the right with a pen tablet, a large screen showing a simple game scene mock and color swatch cards. Tiny staff figures at each area, a whiteboard connecting the spaces, warm night lighting with desk lamps (crunch-before-release but hopeful). Handcrafted clay look, no readable text anywhere.
composition: Wide horizontal interior, slight high angle, one continuous studio floor. Three work areas at roughly 20%/52%/80% width. At least 8% empty margin at both edges. Wall band top 25%, no text.
required_objects: console rack and monitor with crash symbol
